extraction_notes: The supplied PDF is a four-page AP4438 N-Channel Power MOSFET datasheet with footer revision v1.0; all four pages were examined.
The electrical-characteristics table provides VGS(th) minimum 1 V and maximum 3 V at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA, with no typical threshold value.
Both published RDS(on) condition rows were retained, and typical and maximum values were emitted as separate points: 9.5/11.5 mOhm at VGS = 10 V, ID = 11 A, and 13.8/18 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 7 A.

Ciss typical is 790 pF with a published maximum of 1280 pF; the schema has one scalar Ciss field, so the typical value is stored and the maximum is noted here. Coss typical is 125 pF and Crss typical is 105 pF.

The datasheet publishes Qg typical 10.5 nC and maximum 16.8 nC at ID = 11 A, Qgs typical 2.5 nC, Qgd typical 6 nC, gate resistance typical 2.1 ohm, IDSS maximum 10 uA at VDS = 30 V and VGS = 0 V, Qrr typical 14 nC, and trr typical 22 ns; these fields are not present in the supplied schema and are therefore recorded only in this note.
The thermal table publishes Rth-ja maximum 50 degC/W; Rth-jc is not published. The schema has no thermal specification field.

Curve points are conservative manual digitizations of visible grid locations from the cited figures. No points were extrapolated beyond the plotted ranges, and no transfer-characteristics figure was published.
